description_en: Lists the AccessKey IDs for attached multicloud accounts
description_zh: 查看已经绑定的多云AccessKeyId列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-account-access-id --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAccountAccessId

parameters.help_en: The code for the multicloud environment
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select the region of the Management Center based on where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of a member. This parameter allows an administrator to switch to the member's view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The type of view. Valid values:

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts in your enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

AccessIdMd5.description_en: The MD5 value of the multicloud AccessKey ID

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

AccountStr.description_en: The information of the account to which the multicloud AccessKey ID belongs. The format is: Alibaba Cloud account ID|Alibaba Cloud account name|Multicloud AccessKey ID
AccountStr.description_zh: 多云AccessKeyId所属的账号信息，格式为阿里云账号ID|阿里云账号名称|多云AccessKeyId
AccountStr.title_zh: 多云AccessKeyId所属的账号信息，格式为阿里云账号ID|阿里云账号名称|多云AccessKeyId。

Bound.description_en:

0: Not attached.

1: Attached

0 : 未绑定。
1：已绑定

SubUserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that corresponds to the multicloud AccessKey ID

SubUserId.title_zh: 多云AccessKeyId对应的阿里云账号ID。
